_read_me: Copy to docs/STAFF_APPROVAL.json (gitignored: it names people) and fill in. publish_city_site.py refuses to publish the City staff site without a responsible adult, a corrections contact and a sunset date. See docs/STAFF_SITE.md.

city_requestor._note: who at the City asked, in writing, for access; record it before issuing any sign-in

trust_determination._note: the City's answer to whether its TRUST Ordinance (SDMC ch. 2, art. 10, div. 1) applies
